description: False-colour infrared satellite imagery from Spot 5 (2.5 m resolution, 1/2/3 band combination) acquired on 2010-07-14, depicting an airport and its surrounding area in Worms, Germany. The image is attributed to CNES 2011©, Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image. The central region of the airport is marked with the number "1240", indicating its classification as "Airports and associated land" within a land use/land cover (LULC) nomenclature system such as CORINE Land Cover (CLC). The airport complex features extensive artificial surfaces, including runways, taxiways, and buildings, which appear in shades of blue and cyan. Associated grassland areas within the airport perimeter are visible in bright red tones, indicating healthy vegetation in this false-colour composite. Surrounding the airport are agricultural fields, also appearing in bright red, and urban or developed areas with a mix of artificial surfaces and vegetation.
